entities.summary: Zahra Amir Ebrahimi, known professionally as Zar Amir Ebrahimi, is an Iranian and French actress, producer and director. She rose to international prominence for her performance as journalist Arezoo Rahimi in the crime thriller Holy Spider (2022), for which she won the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actress and Robert Award for Best Actress.
